shared_elements: upright freestanding carved slab/pillar as the decorated surface
relief carving covering the broad face
animals rendered in profile (quadruped, bird/waterfowl in A; zoomorphic heads in B)
register-like horizontal division of the surface
row of repeated small motifs across the top of the face
justification: Both are upright carved slabs whose broad faces bear relief with animals in profile and a repeated row of motifs along an upper band, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. A depicts a sparse arrangement of isolated large animals (quadruped, waterbird, snake-like forms) on plain ground with a fringed band, while B is densely packed with a columnar sequence of square glyph-like blocks flanking an elaborate ornamented human figure with headdress — different subjects, different density, and different compositional logic.
